modules.module_title: Wash fruits and vegetables under supervision

pcs.pc_description: receive fruits and vegetables from the supervisor.
Wash and rinse fruits manually (or) dump fruits manually/ through conveyor belt into washing tank.
switch on agitator of revolving screens/blades to immerse each fruit into water to remove dirt, soil, etc.
start ladder conveyor to lift fruits from the washing tank and transfer to washing line conveyor.
open valves of the high-pressure spraying system to spray chlorinated water on fruits and vegetables and rinse with fresh water.

modules.module_title: Sort, peel, slice/grate and blanch fruits and vegetables under supervision

pcs.pc_description: check and remove damaged, blemished and rotten fruits and dispose waste.
start conveyor or elevator to transfer sorted fruits and vegetables into peeler or corer machine.
start conveyor to carry fruit and vegetables through lye peeling machine or load by hand, observe fruit and vegetable emerging from machine to ensure removal of skin or membrane (or)
turn valves to introduce steam for steam peeling of fruits and vegetables and open valves of water spraying system to wash the peeled/ scalded fruits and vegetables.
start conveyor to transfer fruits and vegetable to chopper/cutter/slicer machine to slice to specified size and shape as per SOP.
Operate machine and fill water in the blanching machine for blanching of different types of fruits and vegetables following sop.
examine blanched fruits and vegetables visually and through feel/texture to determine adequacy of softening.
take assistance from supervisor/colleagues for speed control, temperature setting or time setting & pressure control etc. if required.

modules.module_title: Sun dry fruits and vegetables under supervision

pcs.pc_description: weigh pre-processed fruits and vegetables for drying, load in tray, shake/tap trays manually or pass trays though vibrator machines to vibrate for uniform spreading.

transfer loaded trays to the drying area/yard, arrange in rows in drying area for exposure to direct sunlight, allow to stand until fruits and vegetable are completely dried drying time depends on intensity of sunlight), check drying produce periodically to check the completeness of drying.
check the dried fruits and vegetables through feel and dryness to ensure complete removal of moisture.
transfer dried product into scraping line, scrap trays manually using scrapper to remove dried product from the trays.

start vibrating mesh conveyor and control vibration, transfer dried product on the conveyor to vibrate products and to remove any undesirable particles, start conveyor to transfer dried product to finished product inspection line.

pcs.pc_description: load raw material (fruits and vegetables) cartons/crates in freezing room.
monitor frequently and check frozen raw materials to ensure it is completely frozen (i.e., converted to ice crystals).
Inspect visually the frozen products and remove produce non-conforming to standards.
Load checked products in carts or trays and move into cold storage room/chamber.
open freeze-drying chamber after specified time, unload cart, check freeze dried product through physical parameters like colour, flavour, appearance, dryness (through feel) etc.
transfer the product to bins or boxes and hold for specified time and check moisture content as per standards.
send sample product to lab for quality check.

modules.module_title: Inspect and pack dried/dehydrated fruits and vegetables

pcs.pc_description: load packing materials in packaging machine and set packing quantity, set date coding machine for date code details like batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry etc.
start automatic packaging machine to form, fill and seal measured quantity of finished products.
transfer sample packed product to quality lab for analysis and to ensure its conformance to quality standards.
place packed and labelled products in cartons and transfer to storage area.
clean the work area, machineries, equipment and tools using recommended cleaning agents and sanitizers.
